title: Drain Myth: Chemical Cleaners Cure All
description: Many property owners reach for harsh chemical drain cleaners at the first sign of a slow drain, believing it is a universal fix. However, chemical cleaners often fail to clear heavy blockages, especially further down the line or in grease-clogged pipes. Worse, these caustic chemicals can sit against the bottom of pipes, generating extreme heat that damages PVC or corrodes older metallic lines. Professional plumbers know that mechanical clearing methods, such as augering or hydro-jetting, provide a safer and more permanent solution without compromising the structural integrity of the drainage system.

Drain Myth: Chemical Cleaners Cure All

Many property owners reach for harsh chemical drain cleaners at the first sign of a slow drain, believing it is a universal fix. However, chemical cleaners often fail to clear heavy blockages, especially further down the line or in grease-clogged pipes. Worse, these caustic chemicals can sit against the bottom of pipes, generating extreme heat that damages PVC or corrodes older metallic lines. Professional plumbers know that mechanical clearing methods, such as augering or hydro-jetting, provide a safer and more permanent solution without compromising the structural integrity of the drainage system.
